Academics

We follow the state curriculum of the Kyrgyz Republic and enrich it with an intensive language programme, STEM projects and preparation for olympiads and university.

How we teach

Our approach to learning

Small classes

Teachers have time for each pupil, her questions and her pace.

Learning by doing

Experiments, projects and presentations make knowledge last.

Clear feedback

Regular assessment and open conversations with parents about progress.

Room to excel

Olympiad groups and extra classes for pupils ready for more.

School stages

From first letters to graduation

Grades 1–4

Primary school

A gentle start to school life with one class teacher who knows each child well.

  • Reading, writing and mathematics
  • English from Grade 1
  • Art, music and handcraft
  • Learning through play and projects

Grades 5–9

Middle school

Specialist subject teachers and the habits of independent study.

  • Science laboratory lessons
  • Informatics and robotics
  • Second and third language development
  • Research and project weeks

Grades 10–11

Senior school

Focused preparation for exams, olympiads and university admission.

  • ORT preparation programme
  • Advanced mathematics and sciences
  • Career guidance and university advice
  • Leadership and volunteering

Subjects

What our girls study

Languages

  • Kyrgyz language and literature
  • Russian language and literature
  • English

Mathematics & sciences

  • Mathematics, algebra, geometry
  • Physics
  • Chemistry
  • Biology
  • Informatics

Humanities

  • History of Kyrgyzstan
  • World history
  • Geography
  • Man and society

Arts & wellbeing

  • Fine art
  • Music
  • Technology and crafts
  • Physical education

Languages

Three languages, one confident voice

Our pupils learn Kyrgyz, Russian and English every week. English lessons are held in small groups by level, with speaking clubs, reading programmes and preparation for international certificates for older pupils.
